title: statusline r10 UX: malformed-state diagnostic has no content bar
description: Round 10. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Owner: SO session. Defect: the broken-state mark routes the operator to a diagnostic specified only as 'a diagnostic, never a panic' — its settings sibling is rustc-shaped naming file, location, casualty, and retry, all falsified; the state diagnostic the path terminates at names nothing. Citations verified: contract:188, :217 vs :162, :187. Proposed: resolved-candidate (same bar: rustc-shaped, names the state file and parse location, names restore-or-repair and the boundary re-run as recovery; criterion falsifies the recovery half).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: the malformed-state human form held to the settings bar — rustc-shaped, names state file and parse location, names restore-or-repair and the boundary re-run as recovery, both halves falsified. Revision: Status detection criterion.
